free_tier.stated: 25 free credits for a new account, where 1 credit equals USD 0.01, so the grant is USD 0.25 of API usage; one-time, and the getting-started guide ties the grant to creating the account with Google's social login. At the listed per-call prices 25 credits buys 3 calls of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (6.5 credits each), 3 of Stable Image Ultra (8), 10 of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Flash (2.5) or 3 of Stable Audio 3.0 (8, up to six minutes of audio each).
free_tier.notes: models: Stable Image Ultra, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, Large Turbo, Medium and Flash, Stable Image Core, SDXL 1.0 from 0.9 credits, Stable Audio 3.0 and 2.5, and upscale, edit, control and 3D services. After the free credits, credits are bought at USD 1 per 100 credits. unverified: whether the free credits expire

record.interface_detail: REST API authenticated with a bearer API key in the Authorization header; up to 10 active keys per account
record.tooling: raw HTTP with an API key created on the platform dashboard
record.chaining: 25 credits is a smoke test for a wrapper rather than a dataset: it proves an API key works end to end and nothing more. A batch of 100 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Flash images costs 250 credits, ten times the grant.

limits.value: 25 free credits per new account, one-time; 1 credit is USD 0.01, so the grant is USD 0.25
150 requests per 10 seconds per API key; exceeding it returns 429 followed by a timeout of 60 seconds

record.binding_note: USD 0.25 of one-time credit is gone after a handful of calls, long before the 150 requests per 10 seconds rate limit matters

identity_cost.detail: an account on a username and password, or a Google account; the getting-started guide says creating the account with Google's social login grants the 25 free credits; no card is needed for the grant, and credits beyond it are bought on the billing dashboard; unverified: whether a phone number or a verification step is asked, and whether a username-and-password account also receives the grant

record.reliability_note: the grant is tied to the Google social-login signup in the getting-started guide, while the pricing page and the key-lookup article say only that new accounts receive 25 free credits
record.confidence_note: the 25 credit grant, the credit price, the per-call credit costs and the rate limit are quoted from vendor pages; credit expiry, the card-free statement and the extra signup steps are unverified.
